firm_data.firm_description: Fischetti & Pesce, LLP specializes in casualty litigation, representing insurance companies and self-insured clients. They offer personalized legal representation with over a century of combined experience.
notable_facts: The firm has over 100 years of combined experience.
They represent clients in New York, including Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island, Nassau County, Suffolk County, Westchester County, Orange County, Rockland County, and Erie County.
The firm retains a Legal Nurse Consultant for assistance in review of complicated medical records and for in-depth medical research.
technology_signals: The firm works with various electronic billing systems including Serengeti, Bottom Line, LSS, Legal Exchange, Quovant, CounselLink and Wolters Kluwer (Collaboration Portal).
